lede: One name bridged the feeds today: Sara Bejlek. She trended on Google in both India and the United States, and her Ningbo Open match against Marie Bouzkova drew a live prediction market, the only crossover the sources shared. Elsewhere they diverged. Tom Skerritt led Wikipedia with 371,141 views, and a magnitude 7.0 earthquake 191 km east-northeast of Nagqu, China topped the day’s 25 logged quakes.
